g.text: The stack — last in, first out
A queue is a line at the coffee shop — first in line is served first.
Tap any row for the plain-English why.
The two simplest structures: a pile you
take from the top, and a line you join at
A stack of plates: you add and remove
from the top only. The last plate on is the
first one off — that is LIFO.
